ModMetaData.name: Vanilla UI+
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Small RimWorld UI improvements that stay close to the vanilla look.
Keeps the right-side HUD in equal-width bars on the colony and the world map. Labels stay on one line with an ellipsis by default. Right-click an alert to snooze that kind of alert for a set number of days (default 3).
Also adds ultrafast without development mode, outdoor temperature, temperature and day/night tints, a colony day counter, reverse alert/letter order, pinned hostiles, bleeding-out alerts, and per-button play-settings hiding.
If you used an older copy with packageId cruesoe.vanillauiplus.alerts, re-enable this mod in your mod list.
